description: Implement Phase 4 messaging end-to-end: WhatsApp and SMS send libraries, the send-message worker job (try WhatsApp, fall back to SMS on failure, record every attempt in the messages table), the BullMQ send-message queue + enqueue, wiring so a paid booking actually triggers send-message (cross-phase bridge since Phase 3 is absent), the WhatsApp delivery-status webhook (GET verify handshake + POST status callbacks), surfacing the meeting link on the confirmation page/status endpoint so a message failure never blocks the customer, extending the worker process to run the BullMQ workers, and tests that run without a live DB/Redis/provider.
steps: lib/whatsapp.ts: export an async `sendWhatsApp` that posts a template message to the WhatsApp Cloud API (`https://graph.facebook.com/v21.0/${WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID}/messages`, Bearer WHATSAPP_TOKEN, body: { messaging_product: 'whatsapp', to, type: 'template', template: { name, language: { code }, components } }). Use the env() helper pattern from lib/payments.ts (throw if token/phone id unset). On non-2xx throw an Error with the response body snippet (mirror createOrder). Return { providerMessageId } parsed from `messages[0].id`. Allow dependency injection of the fetch function (parameter defaulting to global fetch) so tests avoid network.

lib/sms.ts: export an async `sendSMS` that posts to an SMS provider using SMS_API_KEY (generic HTTP POST; keep provider details in one place and documented). Return { providerMessageId }. Throw on non-2xx like whatsapp. Allow an injectable fetch function. Reuse lib/phone.ts toE164 to normalize the destination number in both libs if needed.

lib/messaging.ts (job logic, kept out of worker/ so it is unit-testable): export `sendBookingMessage(bookingId, deps?)` where deps allow injecting the prisma client, sendWhatsApp, and sendSMS. Logic: load the booking (must exist, must have whatsappOptIn true and a whatsappE164 and a meetLink; if opt-in is false, record nothing or a skipped state and return without error per the doc rule 'only message opted-in numbers'; if meetLink missing, this is the Phase-3 gap: throw a retryable error so BullMQ retries later once the link exists). Try WhatsApp first: create a Message row (channel WHATSAPP, template name, status PENDING), call sendWhatsApp, on success update to SENT with providerMessageId. On WhatsApp failure: record that Message row FAILED with the error, then create a second Message row (channel SMS, status PENDING), call sendSMS, update to SENT or FAILED. Return a summary of which channel succeeded. The template name/components should include the meeting link.

lib/queue.ts: add `export const MESSAGE_QUEUE = "messages";` and `export async function enqueueSendMessage(bookingId: string)` mirroring enqueueCreateMeeting exactly (lazy getQueue over the message queue name, deterministic jobId `send-message-${bookingId}`, attempts:5, exponential backoff delay 5000, removeOnComplete {age: 7*86400}, removeOnFail:false). Refactor the lazy single-queue holder to support two queues (a small map keyed by queue name) without changing enqueueCreateMeeting's behavior.

Cross-phase trigger wiring: because Phase 3's create-meeting consumer does not exist, make a paid booking still result in a send-message attempt. In lib/payment-webhook.ts the handler already enqueues create-meeting. Add a documented bridge: also enqueue send-message when the booking is marked PAID. Keep the existing injectable `enqueue` for create-meeting and add a second injectable enqueue (default enqueueSendMessage) so tests stay offline. Add a clear comment that once Phase 3 lands, the create-meeting job will own enqueueing send-message after it sets meetLink; until then this bridge ensures the 'Done when' (a paid booking triggers a send-message attempt) holds, and sendBookingMessage tolerates a missing meetLink by throwing a retryable error so it is retried after the link is set.

worker/index.ts: extend the worker process to also run BullMQ Workers for the message queue (and leave a clearly-labeled TODO/placeholder for the meetings queue that Phase 3 will own). Create worker/jobs/sendMessage.ts exporting a processor that calls lib/messaging.ts sendBookingMessage, following the overview's worker/jobs/*.ts layout. Construct the Worker over an IORedis(REDIS_URL,{maxRetriesPerRequest:null}) connection like lib/queue.ts. Guard worker startup so the process does not crash when REDIS_URL is unset in local/offline runs (log and skip BullMQ workers, keep the hold-expiry setInterval running).

app/api/webhooks/whatsapp/route.ts: implement GET and POST. GET handles Meta's verification handshake: read hub.mode, hub.verify_token, hub.challenge from query params; if hub.mode === 'subscribe' and hub.verify_token === WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN, respond 200 with the raw hub.challenge value (plain text), else 403. POST handles delivery status callbacks: read the raw body, parse Meta's statuses array (entry[].changes[].value.statuses[] with id + status in {sent,delivered,read,failed}), and update the matching Message row (by providerMessageId) to the mapped MessageStatus; record errors[] detail into Message.error for failed. Mirror the payment webhook route shape (raw body first, try/catch, return 200 on success so Meta does not retry a processed callback). Keep DB writes resilient to unknown provider ids (no-op if not found).

Surface the link so a message failure never blocks the customer (doc rule): update app/api/bookings/[id]/route.ts GET select to also return meetLink, and update app/[influencer]/book/BookingFlow.tsx confirmed state to display the meeting link when present (e.g. a clickable Join link) in addition to the existing 'sent to WhatsApp and email' text. Keep behavior graceful when meetLink is null (Phase 3 not wired): show the existing reassurance text.
Update .env usage docs if needed and ensure all new env var reads go through a throw-if-unset helper consistent with lib/payments.ts.

Tests (tsx node:test, mirror tests/payments.test.ts + tests/signature.test.ts style): (a) tests/messaging.test.ts — unit test sendBookingMessage with injected fakes for prisma + sendWhatsApp + sendSMS (no real DB/Redis/network): assert WhatsApp success path marks a WHATSAPP Message SENT; assert WhatsApp failure falls back to SMS and records a FAILED WHATSAPP row + a SENT SMS row (this is the doc 'Done when' fallback); assert opt-out is not messaged; assert missing meetLink throws a retryable error. Use a tiny in-memory fake for the prisma message delegate so it runs with DATABASE_URL unset. (b) tests/whatsapp-webhook.test.ts — pure-logic test of the status-mapping/parsing helper (export the Meta payload parser from the route or a lib) asserting sent/delivered/read/failed map to the right MessageStatus and that the GET verify-token comparison accepts the correct token and rejects a wrong one. Keep these runnable unconditionally (no DB skip) by testing the pure functions; any DB-touching assertions must use the `const skip = process.env.DATABASE_URL ? false : ...` guard.

Update doc/04-messaging.md: check off the tasks completed in code — `lib/whatsapp.ts` and `lib/sms.ts` send functions; Worker job send-message with WhatsApp->SMS fallback; messages table; WhatsApp delivery-status webhook. Leave unchecked (or annotate as external/manual) the Meta Business account + Cloud API number, template approval submission, and SMS provider/DLT registration tasks, since those cannot be done in code.
acceptance_criteria: lib/whatsapp.ts, lib/sms.ts, lib/messaging.ts, worker/jobs/sendMessage.ts, and app/api/webhooks/whatsapp/route.ts exist and typecheck.
lib/queue.ts exports MESSAGE_QUEUE and enqueueSendMessage mirroring enqueueCreateMeeting; enqueueCreateMeeting still works.
A paid booking path triggers a send-message enqueue (verifiable via the injectable enqueue in payment-webhook tests), satisfying the doc 'Done when' first clause.

sendBookingMessage falls back from WhatsApp to SMS on WhatsApp failure and records both attempts in the messages table (verified by tests/messaging.test.ts with injected fakes), satisfying the 'disabling WhatsApp triggers the SMS fallback' clause.
The WhatsApp webhook GET returns the challenge only for the correct verify token and POST maps sent/delivered/read/failed to MessageStatus and updates the matching Message by providerMessageId.
The confirmation page / booking status endpoint exposes meetLink when present so a message failure does not block the customer.
worker/index.ts starts the message BullMQ worker when REDIS_URL is set and does not crash when it is unset.
`npm run typecheck` passes and `npm test` passes (new unit tests run without DB/Redis/network; DB-dependent assertions skip when DATABASE_URL is unset).
doc/04-messaging.md checkboxes updated for the code-completable tasks; manual/external tasks left unchecked or annotated.
verification: Run `npm run typecheck` and confirm it exits 0.

Run `npm test` and confirm all tests pass, including tests/messaging.test.ts (WhatsApp success, SMS fallback, opt-out, missing-link retryable) and tests/whatsapp-webhook.test.ts (status mapping + verify-token), with no reliance on a live DB/Redis/provider.
findings: Implemented Phase 4 messaging end-to-end. Files added: lib/whatsapp.ts (sendWhatsApp template post to Graph API v21.0, injectable fetch, env() throw-if-unset, body-snippet error), lib/sms.ts (sendSMS generic provider POST w/ SMS_API_KEY, optional SMS_API_URL override, toE164 normalize, injectable fetch), lib/messaging.ts (sendBookingMessage with injectable prisma/sendWhatsApp/sendSMS; WhatsApp-first then SMS fallback; records every attempt in messages table; opt-out returns {channel:null,skipped:true} with no rows; missing meetLink throws RetryableMessageError; both-fail throws so BullMQ retries), lib/whatsapp-webhook.ts (pure helpers: mapWhatsAppStatus, isVerifyRequestValid, parseWhatsAppStatuses), app/api/webhooks/whatsapp/route.ts (GET verify handshake returns raw hub.challenge as text/plain only when verify token matches else 403; POST parses statuses and updateMany by providerMessageId, 200 on success/no-op, 500 to let Meta retry on parse failure), worker/jobs/sendMessage.ts (BullMQ processor calling sendBookingMessage). Files modified: lib/queue.ts (added MESSAGE_QUEUE + enqueueSendMessage mirroring enqueueCreateMeeting; refactored single-queue holder into a Map keyed by name, enqueueCreateMeeting behavior unchanged), lib/payment-webhook.ts (cross-phase bridge: added 4th injectable enqueueMessage param defaulting to enqueueSendMessage; on PAID it now enqueues both create-meeting and send-message, documented), worker/index.ts (starts message BullMQ Worker over IORedis when REDIS_URL set; logs+skips workers when unset so hold-expiry keeps running; TODO placeholder for Phase 3 meetings worker), app/api/bookings/[id]/route.ts (added meetLink to select), app/[influencer]/book/BookingFlow.tsx (confirmation state shows clickable Join link when meetLink present via poll; keeps existing reassurance text when null), .env.example (added optional SMS_API_URL), doc/04-messaging.md (checked off code tasks: whatsapp/sms libs, send-message job, messages table, delivery webhook; left Meta account/template approval/SMS DLT unchecked annotated external/manual; added Implementation notes on bridge + link surfacing). Tests added: tests/messaging.test.ts (in-memory fake prisma, unconditional: WhatsApp success->SENT WHATSAPP; WhatsApp fail->FAILED WHATSAPP + SENT SMS; opt-out->no rows; missing meetLink->RetryableMessageError; both fail->throws + both FAILED) and tests/whatsapp-webhook.test.ts (pure: status mapping sent/delivered/read/failed/unknown, verify-token accept/reject, payload parsing incl. failed error extraction and malformed tolerance). Updated tests/payments.test.ts to inject a no-op message enqueue (and assert the bridge fires in the replay test) so existing DB-gated tests stay offline-safe. CROSS-PHASE BRIDGE CONFIRMED: Phase 3 (Google Meet) absent, so payment-webhook enqueues send-message on PAID now; sendBookingMessage tolerates missing meetLink via retryable error until the link is set. VERIFICATION: automated gates (npm run typecheck / npm test / prisma generate) COULD NOT be executed in-sandbox -- node_modules holds only empty placeholder dirs (tsx/dist absent, no node_modules/.bin, generated/prisma absent) and npm registry returns HTTP 403 with no offline cache, so deps are not installable. This is an environment blocker verified in context.json, not a code issue. Verification was done by careful manual review against existing patterns (lib/payments.ts env()+error style, lib/queue.ts BullMQ options, payment webhook raw-body-first shape, test DI + DB-skip style); code is written to typecheck and pass once deps + prisma generate are available. REVIEW FOLLOW-UP (2026-10-08-134155-review.md), 5 issues all addressed: (1) FIXED [security] WhatsApp POST webhook now verifies Meta's X-Hub-Signature-256 before applying any update. Added pure helper verifyMetaSignature(rawBody, header, appSecret) in lib/whatsapp-webhook.ts (strips 'sha256=' prefix, length-checked timingSafeEqual over raw bytes, mirrors verifyWebhookSignature); route reads raw body first and returns 401 on mismatch, mirroring the payment webhook. GET handshake unchanged (verify token). New env var WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET added to .env.example. Unit-tested in tests/whatsapp-webhook.test.ts (accept correct HMAC; reject tampered body/wrong secret/missing header/missing secret/missing-prefix/non-hex). (2) FIXED isVerifyRequestValid now uses a length-checked constant-time compare (safeEqual via node:crypto timingSafeEqual) instead of ===; added a wrong-length-token reject test. (3) FIXED [security] /api/bookings/[id] no longer returns meetLink unconditionally: it is only returned when booking status is terminal paid (PAID/SCHEDULED/COMPLETED), else null. Rationale documented in a code comment and doc/04-messaging.md: endpoint is public/unauthenticated (no auth system yet), meetLink is only ever set post-PAID so a guessed/pre-payment id yields nothing, ids are cuids, and the link is also delivered via WhatsApp/SMS -- so the doc rule 'always show the link on the confirmation page so a message failure never blocks the customer' is still satisfied (confirmation page polls this endpoint after the customer's own paid checkout). Proper session/ownership gating deferred to when auth lands. (4) ACCEPTED/DOCUMENTED attempts:5 kept identical to the meetings queue; added a comment in lib/queue.ts explaining that in this repo state a send-message job enqueued on PAID exhausts retries and lands failed (removeOnFail:false keeps it) because nothing sets meetLink yet, which is acceptable until Phase 3 lands and owns enqueueing send-message AFTER setting the link; raising attempts/backoff now would only mask the missing producer. (5) FIXED parseWhatsAppStatuses no longer emits error:null on non-FAILED statuses -- WhatsAppStatusUpdate.error is now optional and omitted unless status is FAILED; the route only writes the error column when the field is present ('error' in u), so a later DELIVERED/READ callback cannot clobber a prior FAILED's diagnostic error. Status is treated as the single source of truth; documented in code and doc. Added a test asserting error is omitted on DELIVERED. All changes verified by manual review only (toolchain unavailable as above).
